dex.entry: A small crystal-beetle whose wing-cases are faceted like cut gems; it scurries through the Crystoll Vault tunnels collecting fragments of pure diamond crystal to patch its growing shell. The crystal beetle that collects gems for its own shell — adorable self-improvement.

art.silhouette: Beetle-form about the size of a thumb; transparent faceted wing-cases filled with cyan-white crystal shards that catch light; six iridescent legs; eyes are tiny perfect gem-spheres in deep blue.
